description: Authoritative registry of Native Tools, MCP Servers, Antigravity CLI Controls, and Repo Automation.

tools.name: view_file
tools.summary: Read text and binary files with 1-indexed line slicing (max 800 lines) and byte offset pagination.

parameters.name: AbsolutePath
parameters.description: POSIX absolute path to target file.

parameters.name: IsSkillFile
parameters.description: Set to true when executing skill instructions.

guardrails: 1-Based Line Indexing: Line 1 is the first line of the file.
POSIX Path Standard: Absolute paths must use forward slashes (/).

tools.name: write_to_file
tools.summary: Create new files or overwrite existing files with complete code contents.

parameters.name: Overwrite
parameters.description: Must be true to overwrite existing files.

parameters.name: ArtifactMetadata
parameters.description: Metadata for artifact documents in brain directory.

guardrails: Artifact Metadata: Must include ArtifactMetadata when writing files to the brain directory.
POSIX Paths: Forward slashes strictly required.

tools.name: replace_file_content
tools.summary: Precise single contiguous block find-and-replace using exact byte-for-byte character matching.
tools.usage: replace_file_content(TargetFile, TargetContent, ReplacementContent, StartLine, EndLine, Instruction, Description)

parameters.name: TargetFile
parameters.description: POSIX absolute path to target file.

parameters.name: TargetContent
parameters.description: Exact text block to replace with exact whitespace.

parameters.name: ReplacementContent
parameters.description: New content to replace TargetContent with.

guardrails: Exact Verbatim Whitespace: TargetContent must match character-by-character.
Single Occurrence Invariant: Must uniquely match exactly one block in the file.

parameters.Description: Set debug mode dynamically based on NODE_ENV

tools.name: multi_replace_file_content
tools.summary: Atomic multi-chunk find-and-replace across non-contiguous blocks in a file.

parameters.name: TargetFile
parameters.description: POSIX absolute path to target file.

parameters.name: ReplacementChunks
parameters.description: Array of ReplacementChunk objects with StartLine, EndLine, TargetContent, ReplacementContent.

guardrails: Non-Overlapping Chunks: Provide ordered, disjoint line ranges.
Exact Matching: Every chunk TargetContent must match file contents exactly.

parameters.Description: Make port configurable via environment variable

tools.name: list_dir
tools.summary: Explore directory contents, relative paths, file sizes, and recursive child counts.

parameters.name: DirectoryPath
parameters.description: POSIX absolute path to target directory.

guardrails: Absolute Paths: Must supply absolute POSIX path.

tools.name: grep_search
tools.summary: Fast ripgrep code search with regex, case-insensitivity, and glob filtering (capped at 50 matches).
tools.usage: grep_search(SearchPath, Query, IsRegex, CaseInsensitive, MatchPerLine, Includes)

parameters.name: SearchPath
parameters.description: Absolute directory or file path to search.

parameters.name: MatchPerLine
parameters.description: Return line numbers and line content snippets.

guardrails: Result Cap: Results capped at 50 matches. Use Includes to refine scope.

tools.name: run_command
tools.summary: Execute shell commands in Git Bash POSIX terminal (sync or background daemon).

parameters.name: Cwd
parameters.description: Target working directory as an absolute POSIX path.

parameters.name: IsDaemon
parameters.description: Set true for long-running support processes.

parameters.name: WaitMsBeforeAsync
parameters.description: Milliseconds to wait before sending command to background.

guardrails: No cd Commands: Never use 'cd' inside CommandLine. Specify the Cwd parameter.
Reactive Wakeup: Do not poll manage_task for background processes; yield execution.

tools.name: manage_task
tools.summary: Manage, monitor, tail logs, send input to, or terminate asynchronous background processes.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: Task identifier (required for kill, status, send_input).

parameters.name: Input
parameters.description: Input string to send to background process stdin.

guardrails: No Busy-Wait Polling: Do not loop on Action='status'; wait for system Reactive Wakeup notifications.

tools.name: define_subagent
tools.summary: Dynamically registers new specialized subagent blueprints for the duration of the conversation.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Identifier name for the subagent blueprint.

parameters.name: system_prompt
parameters.description: System instruction prompt for the subagent.

parameters.name: enable_mcp_tools
parameters.description: Allow subagent to use MCP tools.

guardrails: Ephemeral Scope: Blueprint registrations persist only for the current conversation.

tools.name: invoke_subagent
tools.summary: Spawn asynchronous subagent instances for concurrent task execution with model routing.
guardrails: Subagent Output Contract: Subagents MUST deliver all findings via send_message.

tools.name: send_message
tools.summary: Inter-agent communication bus for relaying reports and structured findings between agents.
guardrails: Agent-Only Scope: Never use send_message to communicate with the human user.

tools.name: manage_subagents
tools.summary: Inspect active subagents, view conversation IDs, check lifecycle states, or terminate instances.

parameters.name: ConversationIds
parameters.description: Target conversation IDs for kill action.

guardrails: No Polling: Do not continuously list subagents; wait for notifications.

tools.name: search_web
tools.summary: Performs Google web search for public knowledge, documentation, or technical discussions.
guardrails: Context7 Precedence: Always query Context7 MCP for official library documentation first.

parameters.query: Prisma serverless postgres connection pool limit

tools.name: read_url_content
tools.summary: Fetches public web page content via HTTP request and converts HTML into clean markdown.
guardrails: No JavaScript: This tool performs plain HTTP requests; for dynamic JS apps use Playwright or Firecrawl.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.summary: Generates or edits UI mockups and graphics saved as visual artifacts.

parameters.name: ImageName
parameters.description: All lowercase filename with underscores (max 3 words).

guardrails: No Device Frames: Generate the interface itself without surrounding phone/laptop bezels unless requested.

parameters.Prompt: Modern dark mode SaaS dashboard with telemetry charts

tools.name: ask_question
tools.summary: Renders interactive modal for clarifying underspecified requirements or choosing designs.

parameters.name: questions
parameters.description: Array of question objects with question, options, is_multi_select.

guardrails: Concise Options: Provide clear, discrete choices for the user.

tools.name: schedule
tools.summary: Schedule one-shot timers with cancellation conditions or recurring cron notifications.

parameters.name: Prompt
parameters.description: Message to send upon timer expiration.

parameters.name: DurationSeconds
parameters.description: Number of seconds for one-shot timer.

parameters.name: TimerCondition
parameters.description: Early termination condition: 'never', 'any', or sender ID.

guardrails: No Sleep Commands: Never run bash sleep; use schedule instead.
Mutual Exclusivity: Provide exactly one of DurationSeconds or CronExpression.

parameters.Prompt: Check build status after compilation window

tools.name: call_mcp_tool
tools.summary: Dynamic RPC gateway to execute lazy-loaded tools from configured MCP servers.

parameters.name: ToolName
parameters.description: Target tool name on the server.

guardrails: Check Schema: Read tool schema file in .gemini/antigravity/mcp before invoking lazy tools.

tools.name: list_resources
tools.summary: Lists available static resources exposed by an MCP server.
guardrails: Server Must Support Resources: Check if server exposes resource endpoints.

tools.name: read_resource
tools.summary: Retrieves contents of a specific MCP server resource URI.
guardrails: Valid URI: URI must match an exposed resource from list_resources.

tools.name: context7
tools.summary: Authoritative real-time documentation retrieval for developer libraries and SDKs.
guardrails: Precedence Rule: Always call Context7 before searching the public web.

tools.name: graphify
tools.summary: Codebase structural ontology, God node detection, and dependency impact analysis.

parameters.name: question
parameters.description: Natural language question, keyword search, or symbol path.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Traversal mode: 'bfs' for broad context, 'dfs' for deep path tracing.

parameters.name: token_budget
parameters.description: Maximum tokens allocated for output context.

guardrails: Layer 0 Boot: Run during initial context boot to map architectural blast radius.
Mode Selection: Use bfs for broad exploration; use dfs to trace precise dependency chains.

tools.name: shortest_path
tools.summary: Find the shortest dependency and execution path between two concepts in the knowledge graph.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Source concept label, function, or keyword.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Target concept label, function, or keyword.

guardrails: Blast Radius Analysis: Use shortest_path to verify if modifying node A directly impacts node B.

tools.name: god_nodes
tools.summary: Identify architectural hub nodes with the highest degree of incoming/outgoing connections (high blast radius).
guardrails: High-Risk Modifiers: Nodes with 50+ edges require extra scrutiny and comprehensive test coverage.

tools.name: get_node
tools.summary: Retrieve full details, source location, and degree for a specific graph node by label or ID.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Node label, symbol name, or exact ID.

guardrails: Exact Match: Provide exact symbol or filename for deterministic node metadata.

tools.name: get_neighbors
tools.summary: Retrieve all direct incoming and outgoing neighbor nodes with edge relations and confidence scores.
guardrails: Immediate Impact: Use to check direct callers and importers before refactoring.

tools.name: get_community
tools.summary: Retrieve all nodes within an architectural cluster/community by community ID.
guardrails: Architectural Boundaries: Check community cohesion before creating cross-module dependencies.

tools.name: graph_stats
tools.summary: Retrieve knowledge graph topological statistics (node count, edge count, density, modularity).
guardrails: Audit overall codebase connectivity and complexity metrics.

tools.name: mcp-server-neon
tools.summary: Neon Serverless Postgres database management, instant branching, live SQL, and query tuning.
guardrails: Ephemeral Branches: Always test migrations on separate branches prior to merging.

tools.name: Sanity
tools.summary: Headless CMS Content Lake, live GROQ querying, document mutations, and draft releases.
guardrails: Preserve System Fields: Preserve _id, _type, and _rev when patching documents.

tools.name: cloudflare-bindings
tools.summary: Manage Cloudflare Edge primitives: D1 SQL, KV storage, R2 object store, and Worker scripts.
guardrails: SQLite Dialect: Use SQLite syntax for D1; bind parameters to prevent injection.

tools.name: cloudflare-observability
tools.summary: Query live Worker telemetry logs, observability values, and execution metrics.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Filter or query string for logs.

guardrails: Inspect production exceptions and response latency directly from Edge runtime.

tools.name: cloudflare-docs
tools.summary: Authoritative Cloudflare developer documentation and Pages-to-Workers migration guides.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query for Cloudflare platform docs.

guardrails: Use for Workers, Pages, Hyperdrive, KV, and OpenNext configuration questions.

tools.name: cloudflare-builds
tools.summary: Inspect live Cloudflare Worker and Pages build pipelines, deployments, and build logs.
guardrails: Audit remote build failures and deployment status.

tools.name: playwright
tools.summary: Automated headless browser navigation, E2E testing, visual snapshots, and DOM interaction.
guardrails: Snapshot First: Always capture accessibility snapshot to find real element IDs.

tools.name: browser-use
tools.summary: Autonomous cloud browser agent for multi-step web workflows and complex interactions.
guardrails: Ideal for multi-page flows requiring session persistence across tabs.

tools.name: firecrawl
tools.summary: Advanced web scraping, recursive crawling, markdown extraction, and arXiv research search.
guardrails: Markdown Sanitization: Strips navigation fluff and extracts pure markdown.

tools.name: github
tools.summary: GitHub platform operations: pull requests, issue triage, branch management, and reviews.
guardrails: Conventional Commits: Use standard prefixes (feat:, fix:, docs:, refactor:).

tools.name: filesystem
tools.summary: Local filesystem operations fallback for allowed directory boundaries.
guardrails: Native tools (view_file, write_to_file) take precedence over filesystem MCP.

tools.name: memory
tools.summary: Persistent knowledge graph memory across developer sessions and agent handoffs.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: List of knowledge entities to persist.

guardrails: Store architectural decisions and persistent team conventions.

entities.name: AuthSystem
observations: Uses NextAuth with JWT on Edge

tools.name: notion-mcp-server
tools.summary: Notion workspace integration, task management, and document synchronization.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search term for Notion workspace pages and databases.

guardrails: Synchronize requirements and team documentation from Notion pages.

tools.name: sequential-thinking
tools.summary: Dynamic multi-step reasoning protocol for complex mathematical or architectural planning.

parameters.name: thoughtNumber
parameters.description: Current step number in reasoning chain.

guardrails: Use when formulating complex migration sequences or multi-tier refactorings.

tools.name: token-optimizer
tools.summary: Context hygiene, session compression, AST grep, predictive caching, and token budgeting.
guardrails: AST Search: Matches syntax tree nodes rather than raw character text.

tools.name: agy
tools.summary: Launch interactive Terminal User Interface (TUI) coding session.

parameters.name: --resume
parameters.description: Resume previous session by conversation UUID.

guardrails: Use agy for interactive TUI and agy -p for headless scripting.

tools.name: agy -p
tools.summary: Non-interactive headless single-shot execution for scripts and CI/CD pipelines.
guardrails: Use --dangerously-skip-permissions only in automated sandbox CI runners.

tools.name: agy --resume
tools.summary: Reconnect to a previous conversation state with preserved context and history.
guardrails: Preserves all past tool calls, thoughts, and workspace changes.

tools.name: agy auth
tools.summary: Manage user authentication, API keys, and account login status.
tools.usage: agy auth login | agy auth status | agy auth logout
guardrails: Use agy auth status to verify account tier and quotas.

tools.name: agy config
tools.summary: Inspect and set global platform settings, telemetry, and default models.
tools.usage: agy config get <key> | agy config set <key> <value>
guardrails: Global configurations stored in user home directory.

tools.name: /compact
tools.summary: Manually trigger conversation context compaction to reclaim tokens.

parameters.name: directives
parameters.description: Specific files or invariants to preserve.

guardrails: Trigger /compact when session token usage exceeds 60% capacity.

parameters.directives: Preserve active refactoring plan for src/middleware.ts

tools.name: /stats
tools.summary: Display active session token usage, latency metrics, and API quota.
guardrails: Useful for auditing token consumption during long development sessions.

tools.name: /model
tools.summary: Switch active LLM model tier (e.g. gemini-2.5-pro vs gemini-2.5-flash).
guardrails: Select flash for speed/lookups and pro for deep architecture and synthesis.

tools.name: /checkpoint
tools.summary: Create an immutable point-in-time snapshot of conversation and file state.
guardrails: Create checkpoints before destructive refactorings.

tools.name: /clear
tools.summary: Reset conversation transcript while retaining project context.
guardrails: Clears turn history without modifying workspace files.

tools.name: /export
tools.summary: Export active conversation log to local Markdown/JSON format.
guardrails: Saves full conversation turns and tool calls.

tools.name: /exit
tools.summary: Safely terminate the active CLI session.
guardrails: Flushes logs and closes open sockets.

tools.name: /opsx-propose
tools.summary: OpenSpec SDD: Propose a new change (proposal, specs, design, tasks) without writing code.
guardrails: Never write implementation code during the propose phase.

parameters.description: Add sliding window rate limiter to /api/auth

tools.name: /opsx-apply
tools.summary: OpenSpec SDD: Sequentially implement task checklists from approved OpenSpec delta change.
guardrails: Implement tasks strictly according to tasks.md checklist.

tools.name: /opsx-verify
tools.summary: OpenSpec SDD: Verify codebase changes against specifications, tests, and design requirements.
guardrails: Run unit tests, lint checks, and spec compliance audits.

tools.name: /opsx-archive
tools.summary: OpenSpec SDD: Archive completed change proposal and sync delta specs to main specification root.
guardrails: Only archive after all tasks are completed and verified.

tools.name: /opsx-sync
tools.summary: OpenSpec SDD: Sync delta specs directly to main specifications without archiving.
guardrails: Merges specification deltas into canonical specs.

tools.name: /opsx-new
tools.summary: OpenSpec SDD: Start a new step-by-step change lifecycle with guided prompt questions.
guardrails: Guides developer through proposal template creation.

tools.name: /opsx-ff
tools.summary: OpenSpec SDD: Fast-forward through OpenSpec artifact creation in one go.
guardrails: Generates proposal, specs, design, and tasks simultaneously.

tools.name: validate-ai-docs.cjs
tools.summary: Validate Markdown docs against the 7-Pillars standard (frontmatter, links, TL;DR).
guardrails: Ensures all markdown documents comply with AI-Friendly documentation principles.

tools.name: generate-docs-manifests.cjs
tools.summary: Generate token-lean index manifests for AI context harvesting and prompt injection.
guardrails: Creates lean index files for rapid agent boot.

tools.name: ensure-tldr.cjs
tools.summary: Enforce machine-readable TL;DR summary blocks in all project documentation.
guardrails: Verifies every markdown document starts with a structured TL;DR block.

tools.name: reconcile-docs-links.cjs
tools.summary: Check and fix relative and absolute markdown document links across the repository.
guardrails: Ensures no broken links exist between documentation files.

tools.name: help.js
tools.summary: Deterministic tool catalog runner, parameter inspector, prompt generator, and system doctor.
guardrails: Zero external dependencies; runs in <300ms.

tools.name: harness-audit.js
tools.summary: Execute deterministic 12-category harness audit producing a 0-10 scorecard.
guardrails: Audits tool parity, documentation standards, and agent capability coverage.

tools.name: platform-audit.js
tools.summary: Audit Cloudflare Pages Edge, Neon Postgres, and Sanity CMS bindings and connectivity.
guardrails: Validates all remote cloud platform configurations.

tools.name: quality-gate.js
tools.summary: Run ECC formatter and quality gate verification for targeted files.
guardrails: Enforces strict typing, linting, and formatting standards.

tools.name: mcp-health-check.js
tools.summary: Probe and report connectivity status of all configured MCP servers.
guardrails: Verifies socket and transport connectivity to all active MCP bridges.

tools.name: graphify reflect
tools.summary: Graphify Work Memory: Aggregate agent Q&A lessons into LESSONS.md and create .graphify_learning.json overlay.

parameters.name: --if-stale
parameters.description: No-op when LESSONS.md is already newer than memory logs.

parameters.name: --out
parameters.description: Custom output path for lessons markdown (default: docs/LESSONS.md).

guardrails: Layer 6 Memory Sync: Run graphify reflect at the end of feature workflows to persist learnings.
Work Memory Overlay: Generates .graphify_learning.json tagging nodes as preferred/tentative/contested.

tools.name: graphify extract --code-only
tools.summary: Graphify AST Extraction: Deterministically parse local codebase AST without requiring LLM vision or API keys.

parameters.name: directory
parameters.description: POSIX path to target directory to extract.

parameters.name: --code-only
parameters.description: Extract code only using local AST parsers.

parameters.name: --directed
parameters.description: Preserve directed call and import edges.

guardrails: Zero API Quota: Extracts complete architectural graph locally without external LLM calls.

tools.name: graphify path
tools.summary: Graphify CLI Path Tracer: Find the shortest connection path between two named concepts from terminal.
guardrails: Fast Dependency Check: Instant terminal verification of concept connections without launching MCP.
